description_for_human: Plan office days, book desks and rooms, and review workplace utilization.
description_for_model: Tactic is the user's workplace management system and the only source of their workplace data. Always call Tactic in the current turn for any question about: the user's or colleagues' reservations and bookings, desks, meeting rooms, parking, offices and floors, who is in the office, working locations, check-in and check-out, visitors, workplace requests and workplace utilization reports. Never answer these from memory and never say the data is not available without calling Tactic first.

get_floor_occupancy
functions.description:
Gets who is booked in an office on a day, grouped by floor: each person with the resource (desk, meeting room, parking...), their times and whether they checked in. Private reservations show no person. Pass resource_id (e.g. the desk the user booked that day, from get_users_working_locations_at_week) to only get the people on that floor, or floor_id or zone_id from list_office_places for a floor or zone the user names. Use it for "who's near me", "who's on my floor" or "who's sitting next to ..." questions. Example:
- {"office":"Lisbon HQ","date":"2026-10-02","total":2,"floors":[{"id":"reso_...","name":"Floor 2","occupants":[{"resource":{"id":"reso_...","name":"Desk 12","resource_type":"desk"},"user":{"id":"user_...","name":"Ada Lovelace","email":"ada@example.com"},"start":"2026-10-02T09:00:00","end":"2026-10-02T17:00:00","checked_in":true},{"resource":{"id":"reso_...","name":"Desk 14","resource_type":"desk"},"user":"private reservation","start":"2026-10-02T09:00:00","end":"2026-10-02T17:00:00","checked_in":false}]}]}

functions.name: get_my_workplace_requests
functions.description:
Lists the workplace requests the current user submitted, newest first, with their status, priority, who they are assigned to and when they were last updated. Use it when the user asks about their requests, e.g. "what happened to my monitor request?" (search "monitor"), "do I have open requests?". Then show them with show_workplace_requests.
Example response: {"requests":[{"id":"0190a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000aa","number":3073,"title":"Broken monitor","type":"IT","status":"In progress","base_status":"open","priority":"medium","office":"Lisbon HQ","location":"Desk 187","assigned_to":"Ana Silva","created":"2026-10-01 09:12","updated":"2026-10-02 10:30","url":"https://..."}],"total":1}

functions.name: get_users_in_office_at_week
get_users_working_locations_at_week
get_workplace_request
functions.description: Gets one workplace request by its ID or number (e.g. 3073) with its activity: comments and changes (status, assignee, priority...) oldest first. Use it to explain where a request stands and what happened to it. Then show it with show_workplace_requests.

functions.name: get_workplace_requests_summary
functions.description: For people who manage workplace requests: summarizes the unresolved (open and pending) requests they manage, optionally for one office. Returns the counts by status, type, office and floor, how many are unassigned, the high priority ones and the oldest ones. Use it for "what should my team work on first?", "summarize open requests by floor". Suggest priorities from high priority, age, unassigned requests and where they pile up. If there are none, the user doesn't manage any open requests.

functions.name: list_office_places
functions.description:
Lists the floors and zones of an office with their IDs. Zones are parts of the floor plans such as a team's area ("Engineering"), a quiet area or a single room; a zone covers everything drawn inside it, smaller zones included, plus its sub-zones, and can span floors. Use it when the user names a floor or a zone, then pass its ID as floor_id or zone_id to find_available_resources or get_floor_occupancy. Match the user's words to the names (e.g. "floor 2", "second floor" -> "Floor 2"); if nothing matches, say which floors and zones there are. Example:
- {"office":"Lisbon HQ","floors":[{"id":"reso_...","name":"Floor 1"},{"id":"reso_...","name":"Floor 2"}],"zones":[{"id":"zone_...","name":"Engineering","desks":24,"meeting_rooms":2},{"id":"zone_...","name":"Platform team","parent":"Engineering","desks":8,"meeting_rooms":0}]}

functions.name: list_offices
functions.description:
Lists the offices the user can use with their IDs, by name, optionally only the ones matching a query (name, city, state or country). Use it when the user names an office that isn't in their context, e.g. "book a desk in Madrid", or asks which offices there are. total is how many match; only the first 200 are listed. Example:
- {"offices":[{"id":"offi_...","name":"Madrid Castellana","city":"Madrid","country":"Spain","timezone":"Europe/Madrid"}],"total":1}

functions.name: list_report_boards
functions.description: Lists the user's report boards (default boards and their own) with the questions on each. Use it to answer what is on a board, or to find where to save a report.

functions.name: list_workplace_request_types
functions.description: Lists the types of workplace requests (e.g. broken equipment, cleaning, catering) the user can create, with their IDs and when to use each one.

functions.name: move_reservation
functions.description: Moves a reservation of the current user to another resource and/or time, keeping its attendees. Show the change first with `show_reservation_change` and only call this tool once the user confirmed it. The resource ID must come from `find_available_resources`. Times are in the office's local time.

functions.name: release_reservations
functions.description: Releases reservations of the current user for a day, e.g. when they are sick or not coming in, and optionally their dedicated desk that day. Show them first with `show_release_reservations` and only call this tool once the user confirmed it.

functions.name: report_outlook
functions.description: Looks ahead: how busy each office is expected to be on the next ten working days (today included), from what is booked already and how days of that weekday usually fill up. Use it for questions about the coming days or weeks: "how busy will next Tuesday be", "is Wednesday going to be full", "when is the quietest day to come in", "is there room for my team on Thursday". Returns, per office and day, what is booked so far, where the day is heading (expected), the inventory, the expected share in percent, what a usual such day ends at, and how sure the forecast is. Answer in words with the expected number and share against the inventory; say when confidence is low. Never use build_report_query for the future, it only looks back.

functions.name: save_report_to_board
functions.description: Pins a report query on one of the user's boards when they ask to save, pin or add a report to a board. Use the exact query that build_report_query ran. Match board_name to one of their editable boards from list_report_boards; if none matches, a new private board with that name is created. Confirm what was saved and where.

functions.name: search_offices_documents
functions.description:
Searches for information linked to offices documents. If the user asks for information about policies, procedures, events or anything else you don't have information about, use this tool to try to find relevant information.
- The tool does semantic search, use expressive queries to find relevant information.
- It returns a map of office ids with the information found for each one.
- If nothing was found for a specific office, it will not be included in the response.
- Example responses:
  - Found information for "Main Office" but not for "Main Office 2": {"offices_information":{"offi_3b168e50-4dc0-44eb-97d3-010207c4c751":{"office": {"id": "offi_3b168e50-4dc0-44eb-97d3-010207c4c751", "name": "Main Office"}, "results": ["The office is located in the main building on the 10th floor."]}}}
  - Found information for "Main Office" and "Main Office 2": {"offices_information":{"offi_3b168e50-4dc0-44eb-97d3-010207c4c751":{"office": {"id": "offi_3b168e50-4dc0-44eb-97d3-010207c4c751", "name": "Main Office"}, "results": ["The office has a gym and a parking lot open to the public."]}, "offi_3b168e50-4dc0-44eb-97d3-010207c4c752":{"office": {"id": "offi_3b168e50-4dc0-44eb-97d3-010207c4c752", "name": "Main Office 2"}, "results": ["The office has a gym and a parking lot open to the public."]}}}

functions.name: show_floor_map
functions.description: Shows the map of a floor on a day to the user: who is booked where, which desks are still free and who is in. Use it when the user wants to see a floor or the office, e.g. "show me floor 2 today". Get the floor ID from `list_office_places`.

functions.name: show_release_reservations
functions.description: Shows the current user's reservations for a day as a card they can release, e.g. when they are sick or not coming in. Get the schedule IDs with `get_users_working_locations_at_week`: desks and parking, meeting rooms only when the user asks. The card also offers to release the user's dedicated desk that day. Showing the card releases nothing: it happens when the user confirms in the card or when you call `release_reservations`.

functions.name: show_report
functions.description: Shows a report as a chart, table or floor map after answering an analytics question with `build_report_query`. Pass the exact query the tool ran so the report can be drawn; the summary gives the key numbers.

functions.name: show_reservation_change
functions.description: Shows an existing reservation moved to another resource and/or time as a card the user can confirm. Get the schedule ID with `get_users_working_locations_at_week` and a new resource with `find_available_resources`. Showing the card changes nothing: it happens when the user confirms in the card or when you call `move_reservation`.

functions.name: show_reservation_info
functions.description: Shows proposed reservations to the user as a card they can confirm, including recurring reservations and workplace requests associated to them. Use it after finding resources with `find_available_resources`. Showing the card does not create the reservations: they are created when the user confirms them in the card or when you call `create_reservation`. Only use it with at least one reservation to show, and not for reservations already made (use `show_users_working_locations` for those).

functions.name: show_users_working_locations
functions.description: Shows the working locations of users to the user. Use it after getting working locations with any tool to present the result, including the location of the current user or other users and details about existing reservations. If none of the users have a working location, do not use this tool.

functions.name: show_visit_info
functions.description: Shows a visitor invitation to the user as a form they can review and send. Showing it does not invite the visitor: they are invited when the user sends the form or when you call `create_visit`, and then get an email with a check-in code.

functions.name: show_visits
functions.description: Shows the visitors expected or visiting on a day to the user, after getting them with `get_visits`.

functions.name: show_workplace_request_info
functions.description: Shows a proposed workplace request to the user as a form they can review and submit. Showing it does not create the request: it is created when the user submits the form or when you call `create_workplace_request`.

functions.name: show_workplace_requests
functions.description: Shows existing workplace requests to the user: their status, who they are assigned to and the last update, with the comments and changes when a single request is shown. Use it after `get_my_workplace_requests`, `get_workplace_request` or `get_workplace_requests_summary`, passing the request IDs (not numbers) in the order to show them.

tools.name: list_office_places
tools.description:
Lists the floors and zones of an office with their IDs. Zones are parts of the floor plans such as a team's area ("Engineering"), a quiet area or a single room; a zone covers everything drawn inside it, smaller zones included, plus its sub-zones, and can span floors. Use it when the user names a floor or a zone, then pass its ID as floor_id or zone_id to find_available_resources or get_floor_occupancy. Match the user's words to the names (e.g. "floor 2", "second floor" -> "Floor 2"); if nothing matches, say which floors and zones there are. Example:

tools.name: report_outlook
tools.description: Looks ahead: how busy each office is expected to be on the next ten working days (today included), from what is booked already and how days of that weekday usually fill up. Use it for questions about the coming days or weeks: "how busy will next Tuesday be", "is Wednesday going to be full", "when is the quietest day to come in", "is there room for my team on Thursday". Answer in words with the expected number and share against the inventory; say when confidence is low. Never use build_report_query for the future, it only looks back.

tools.name: search_offices_documents

Searches for information linked to offices documents. If the user asks for information about policies, procedures, events or anything else you don't have information about, use this tool to try to find relevant information.
